A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Learn2Fold and contain readable text, equations, tables, and figures. All nine pages of v1 and thirteen pages of v2, including v2's Appendices A–B, support comparison. v1 has no appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results in Table 1, IID/OOD component ablations in Tables 2–3, and qualitative folding outputs.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results in Table 1, ablations in its combined Table 2, and qualitative folding outputs.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same canonicalization, tokenized proposal policy, graph world model, Level-0 verification, MPC scoring, and resampling procedure. The added dataset section and appendices document the existing system without establishing an algorithmic change.

E1.justification: The experimental text retains 25 origami categories, three difficulty tiers, and IID/OOD crease-pattern settings. However, v2's new Figure 4 lists 50+ categories, conflicting with Section 3.5 and Appendix B. The PDFs do not resolve whether actual training coverage expanded or the illustration is inaccurate.

E2.justification: Table 1 evaluates the same Gemini, GPT-5.1, GPT-5.2, and BrickGPT comparators. The ablations retain LM and LM+WM. Appendix B newly discusses Gemini explicitly, but Gemini already participates in v1's reported comparisons.

E3.justification: The stated split, metrics, training budgets, 3,840 prompts, and 1,150 validation cases remain unchanged. However, new Figure 4 reports 10,000+ sequences and 100,000+ trajectories, while both versions' text states 5,760 and 75,000. This contradiction prevents reliably determining whether dataset sample counts changed.

E4.justification: The same component ablations and qualitative comparisons remain. v1's separate IID/OOD tables are combined in v2. Appendix B mentions additional supplementary examples and failure cases, but no additional such analyses are actually presented in the supplied PDF.

E5.justification: Both versions specify fixed random seeds and two independent runs per prompt, and report the same ablation values with identical plus/minus quantities. The appendix repeats these practices without adding uncertainty definitions, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All 25 metric values in Table 1 and all 18 ablation entries match exactly. For example, Learn2Fold's F1 remains 0.7394 and Cat-SR remains 0.8912. The qualitative output panels are also retained; their relocation and resizing introduce no new performance findings.

T1.justification: The state and action definitions and Equations 1–6 remain mathematically equivalent. Neither the added dataset description nor the appendices introduce new assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about Learn2Fold, the OrigamiCode data engine, physically executable folding, and out-of-distribution generalization. The central contribution scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: v2 removes Section 4.2's trajectory-level discussion interpreting Edge-IoU and Cat-SR, including explanations about missing edge-level causal grounding and the limits of reactive rollback. The broader qualitative and ablation interpretations remain.

D1.justification: Section 3.5 and Figures 4–5 add documentation of parameterized crease-pattern graphs, JSON annotations, boundary constraints, and recorded intermediate geometry. Appendix B explicitly describes rollout termination and shared evaluation interfaces. Most hardware, training-time, and hyperparameter details already appeared in v1.

R1.justification: v2 adds supporting references for LoRA, the GPT-5 system card, and Gemini in the appendices. The substantive related-work discussion and positioning against computational origami, reactive generation, and world models remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Dataset material moves from Section 4.1 into an expanded Section 3.5, Appendices A–B consolidate explanatory material, and one quantitative-discussion paragraph is removed. Most existing prose remains unchanged; author information and citation style also receive editorial updates.

P2.justification: v2 substantially reformats the document, redraws the system overview, and adds dataset-overview and crease-pattern figures. It reduces the full-page folding examples to a column, compresses Table 1, and merges the separate IID/OOD tables. Figure placement, typography, captions, and table structure change extensively.

improvement.justification: The added dataset and protocol explanations provide limited clarity, but new Figure 4 introduces conflicting counts: 50+ categories, 10,000+ sequences, and 100,000+ trajectories versus 25, 5,760, and 75,000 in the retained text. This newly introduced inconsistency weakens the specification of a central contribution and outweighs the modest documentation gains from largely repetitive appendices.
